chapter.ojb_title: Weak of Heart -- Strong of Heart
chapter.eng_title: Weak of Heart -- Strong of Heart

paragraph.text_eng: Now I’m going to tell another story.

sentence.sent_text: Mii go miinawaa bezhig wii-tibaajimoyaan.

paragraph.text_eng: They were still fighting with the Dakotas, the Ojibwes with the Dakotas. And so they went to look for the enemy over here, over here on this side of Chief Mountain. There must be a lake near there somewhere.

sentence.sent_text: Mii go geyaabi go gii-miigaadiwaad ongow bwaanag, anishinaabeg, miinawaa bwaanag.
Mii gaa-izhi-maajaawaad nandobaniwaad owidi, owidi ayi'iing Ogimaa-wajiwing.
Zaaga'igan-sh imaa ayaamagadodog imaa ingoji besho.

paragraph.text_eng: And so they went off, the Ojibwes went off to look for the enemy Dakotas. So they must have camped there, they camped there; In many lodges, in tipis, in lodges, that’s where they camped.

sentence.sent_text: Mii gaa-izhi-maajaawaad, maajaawaad ingiw anishinaabeg nandobaniwaad bwaanan.
Gaa-izhi-gabeshiwaad iidog imaa, gabeshiwaad imaa; Niibowa wiigiwaaman, iniw bajiishka'ogaanan, wiigiwaaman, mii imaa gii-kabeshiwaad.

paragraph.text_eng: HAAW There’s a single chief who is the leader, the one who looks for the enemy. There is a chief who is the leader, he is the chief, who took them into battle.

sentence.sent_text: HAAW Bezhig aw naagaanizid aw ogimaa, mii aw nendobanid.
Mii go aw naagaanizid ogimaa a'aw sa go, ogimaawid, gaa-maajiinaad iniw wii-o-miigaadiwaad.

paragraph.text_eng: WAA His head with feathers arrayed. He is a BRAVE; a BRAVE is he.

sentence.sent_text: WAA Miigwanan imaa oshtigwaaning ezhi'od.
Mii aw OGICHIDAA ; OGICHIDAA Mii aw.

paragraph.text_eng: Now HAA It turns out that there was a battle there, they were camping where the battle was. There must have been a battle there where they were camping.

sentence.sent_text: Zhigwa HAA Gii-miigaadim ingwana imaa, gaa-tazhi-miigaading gii-kabeshiwaad.
Mii imaa gii-miigaadiwiingen imaa dazhi-gabeshiwaad.

paragraph.text_eng: He has a wife; he’s sitting next to her at the doorway, that brave. He leads the battle, he is at the front going into battle. This is that brave sitting at the doorway with his wife. There is a curtain on the door of the lodge.

sentence.sent_text: Wiiwan-sh odayaawaan; mii imaa wenji-wiidabimaad ishkwaandeming, mii a'aw ogichidaa, Wiin igo niigaanizi gaye miigaadiwind wiin igo iwidi niigaan, ani-miigaazod.
Wa'aw idash ogichidaa, mii imaa namadabiwaad ishkwaandeming miinawaa iniw wiiwan.
Gibiiga'igaade dash i'iw ayi'ii ishkwaandem wiigiwaam.

paragraph.text_eng: Suddenly they heard something there at the doorway where that brave is sitting. Suddenly it pulled aside that door of his, their curtained door. Suddenly a head poked through.

sentence.sent_text: Baanimaa go giiwenh gegoo gaa-initamowaad imaa ishkwaandeming mii imaa namadabid a'aw ogichidaa.
Baanimaa go giiwenh imaa ba-dawegishkaanig i'iw ayi'ii odishkwaandem, gibiiga'igaadenig odishkwaandemiwaa.
Baanimaa go giiwenh awiya ba-zaagikweninid.

paragraph.text_eng: With no hair, for he must have been scalped. There is nothing there, just him trying to pull his falling skin aside, trying to pull it aside to see, As he crawls inside.

sentence.sent_text: Mii gaawiin, mii gii-pakwajindibezhwaawinden iniw wiinizisan.
Mii gaawiin gegoo, meta go anishaa go ayipidood iniw ozhaga'ayan imaa bangishininid, anishaa go ayipidood, mii ezhi-waabid, Biindigeyooded imaa zhigwa.

paragraph.text_eng: WAAW When the brave saw him, he stands up, and jumps across the fire, YAAY and falls. The old woman sees him, grabs the axe, and, when she’d clubbed him on his head -- that Dakota -- throws him outside.

sentence.sent_text: WAAW Ogichidaa wayaabamaad, bazigonjise, ezhi-aazhawigwaashkwanid imaa boodawaadenig, YAAY bangishing.
Mii waabamaad aw mindimooyenh, onawadinaan giiwenh waagaakwad, gaa-izhi-niiwanaskindibe'waad iniw -- iniw bwaanan -- mii zaagijiwebinaad.

paragraph.text_eng: Now HAA The brave’s wife had beaten him to it; It was she, the old woman, who was the more strong of heart.

sentence.sent_text: Azhigwa HAA Mii gii-aada'ogod iniw wiiwan aw ogichidaa, Mii wiin nawai gii-soongide'ed aw mindimooyenh.

paragraph.text_eng: HAA Now they held a council of braves, They hold a council now, to decide now how to deal with his bravery.

sentence.sent_text: HAA Zhigwa gaa-izhi-maawanji'idiwaad ongo, ongo ogichidaag, Maawanji'idiwaad zhigwa, dibaakonind zhigwa aaniin ge-izhichigaazod zoongide'e.

paragraph.text_eng: It was this brave who was the more weak of heart; His wife the more strong.

sentence.sent_text: Mii gii-shaagode'ed nawaj aw ogichidaa ; Iniw wiiwan nawaj zoongide'ewan.

paragraph.text_eng: HAA He will be a brave no more; This old woman -- his wife -- will be the brave.

sentence.sent_text: HAA Gaawiin geyaabi da-ogichidaawisiin.
Wa'aw mindimooyenh -- wiiwan -- mii aw ge-ogichidaawid.

paragraph.text_eng: And so that is how he was dealt with: She, the old woman, became a brave; No longer was her husband one.

sentence.sent_text: Mii gaa-izhi-izhi'ind wiin: Wiin dash gii-ogichidaawid aw mindimooyenh; Gaawiin geyaabi iniw odakiwenziiyiman.

paragraph.text_eng: The story-teller who told me this is this same story-teller of mine, this old man. He is called Zhaagobekiwenzhiinh. He lived there at Shakopee Lake; that is where he told me this, this that I have told there.

sentence.sent_text: Wa'aw idash gaa-waawiindamawid gaa-tadibaajimod, mii go geyaabi wa'aw gaa-tadibaajimotawid wa'aw akiwenzii.
Zhaagobekiwenzhiinh izhinikaazo.
Imaa Nesawigamaag gii-taa, mii go imaa gaa-tazhi-dadibaajimotawipan o'o, o'o iwidi debaadodamaan.

paragraph.text_eng: Sometime in the future you can tell it when you remember what he told me.

sentence.sent_text: Ingoding gidaa-ani-dadibaajim mikwendaman mii gaa-izhid.

paragraph.text_eng: HAA I always used to be with him when I stayed with him, when I stayed with him in a lodge. We lived there in a lodge; that’s where he told stories. I used to give him a drink of whiskey to tell stories, always then he’d tell more. I loved to hear him tell stories; that’s why I did that to him so I could learn what had gone on before.

sentence.sent_text: HAA Apane ko ingii-ayaawaa imaa gii-pi-wiiji'ayaawag, gii-pi-wiiji'ayaawag wiigiwaaming.
Wiigiwaaming imaa ingii-abimin; miish imaa gii-tadibaajimod.

Ingii-mina'aa ko ishkodewaaboo ji-dadibaajimod; mii dash eshkam igo, miish iw gaa-tadibaajimod apane Babizindawag minotawag dadibaajimod; mii gaa-onji-izhichigaanag iw ji-gikendamaan aaniin ba-izhiwebak.
Mii iw.
Gichi-mewinzha gii-aawan.
Makwa ingoding giiwenh bakadegobanen.
Megwaa dash igo babaamosed, babaa-nandawaabandang waa-miijid, niibowa ogii-waabandaanan bawa'iminaanan dabasagoodenig imaa bawa'iminagaawanzhiing.
Imaa dash igo ani-nandakwaandawe mitigong, anishaa go, awashime aano-wiikwajitoo ji-debibidood iniw bawa'iminaanan.
Aaniish mii sa iw, eshkam igo eshkam ishpiming imaa akwaandawed, anishaa go apane.
Wa, tayaa!
Mii gaawiin igo ingod gegoo bawa'iminaanan aw makwa ogii-taangandanziin.
Aaniish mii sa iw, ezhi-niisaandawed, azhigwa go ani-maajaa.
Maajaapan dash, mii go giiwenh gaa-ikidod, "Booch!
Geget igo onzaam mashkawisinoon iniw bawa'iminaanishizhan."
Eniwek mewinzha gii-ayaawag ingodwewaan wayaabishkiiweijig.
Niizhoodensag gii-aawiwag.
Waasinid, Menikwed gaye mii ezhinikaazowaad.
Apane iko gii-pabaa-giiyosewag.
Aanawi aapiji gii-kichi-bagandiziwag, ingiw niizhoodensag.
Gii-namadabiwag iko biindig odaabaaning gii-kiiyosewaad.
Ingoding gii-babaamibizowag ji-nandawaabamaad iniw binewan.
Gaa-ishkwaa-dagoshinowaad imaa Gibaakwa'igaansing, aw Waasinid ogii-waabamaan bezhig binewan.
"Wegwaagi!
Besho miikanaang ayaa bezhig," ikido Waasinid.
Ogii-tebibidoon i'iw isa anwii-baashkizigan ji-gagwe-nisaad iniw binewan.
Dash wiin ogii-baashkizwaan iniw odaabaanan.
Gii-pagoneganaanji gaade apakwaan.
Gii-kagiibaadizi aw bine.
Gaawiin animisesii.
Mii dash miinawaa a'aw Waasinid gagwe-nisaad iniw binewan.
Dash wiin ogii-paashkizwaan oniikanisan, Menikwed ezhinikaazod.
Gii-kichi-pagoneganaanji gaade odiyaang.
Gii-ipizowag imaa mashkikiiwigamigong wewiib.
Igo gaye gii-ishkwaane Menikwed.
Azhigwa izhi-wiinzowag ingiw niizhodensag "Waasinid, oniikaanisan Aabita-diy, gaye."
Mii iw akeyaa gaa-kiiyosewaad ingiw niizh wayaabishkiiwejig.
Ingoding igo nigig giiwenh bi-minjiminamogobanen wiiyaas, bangii go.
Imaa dash igo ziibiinsing aazhawaadagaaban, gii-waabandang gegoo, imaa ezhi-mazinichigaazod anaamibiig, dibishkoo go danaasag imaa waabamoojichaagwaaning.
Baabige go dash gii-inendam, "Mii go miinawaa bezhig wemiijimid."
Aaniish, mii sa iw gaa-inendang geget igo.
Gii-ani-maajaa, gaye wiin miinawaa ezhi-mazinichigaazod, maajiishkaamagadinig.
Wa, tayaa!
"Gaawiin igo giga-noopinanisinoon," gii-ikido.
"Gaawiin igo gaye inga-bagidinanziin i'iw isa menjiminamaan."
"Awas!
Geget igo gigikenimin ayaawiyan gosha!"
"Bizhishig mazinichigan gidaaw ingwana!"
Nashke naa, wayeshkad giiwenh bi-ayaawaagobanen imaa eko-wiisagisinaamagadinig gaa-kagwaanisagendaagozijig, wiindigoog eninjig.
Geyaabi sa go ingoding giiwenh niizh ingiw babaamaadiziwag ani-ziigwaninig.
Giizhaa dash igo weweni ogii-ozhitoonaawaa i'iw isa onawapwaaniwaa waa-na'enimowaad, mii sa bezhig abinoojiinsan.
Mii dash geget igo gaa-izhi-maajaawaad, bezhig wiineta go ezhi-bimoomaad iniw abinoojiinsan waa-amwaawaad igo.
Aapiji dash igo ani-aabawaamagadogoban i'iw isa giizhigadinig gaa-maajaawaad.
Baanimaa dash ingoding igo ezhi-babimosewaad, aw dash bezhig wiindigoo zhayiigwa ogii-izhi-moozhitoon imaa omisadaang ji-nonde-wiisinid.
Tayaa hay', eshkam, eshkam ani-godaganaandam.
Naaningim ani-noogigaabawiwag, aapiji ayekoziwaad, gichi-bagidanaamowag ani-bimosewaad.

Iwapii dash ingoding igo megwaa anwebiwaad, aw gewanaandang ezhi-ikidod, "Bekaa naa niijiikiwenz, geget igo onzaam bangiiwagizi iw nayenzh ji-amoongiban, awashime da-onizhishin bezhig eta go ji-amwaad gosha!"
"Ambeshke naa, indaga dawaaj gi ga-ataadimin, ge-bakinaaged, mii aw ge-amwaad."
Aaniish mii sa iw, bezhig dash igo wiindigoo ikido, "Wegonen dash ge-inataadiyang, aaniin igo gaye ge-izhichigewinagakiban?"
Mii sa baabige go ezhi-nakwetaagod, "Giin sa gegiibaadiziyan, nashke sa naa, ge-gichi-giiwanimod, mii
Azhigwa go ezhi-inaabid giiwenh iwidi inagakeyaa, waasa iwidi debaabandang i'iw isa enigoowigamigoons nanaa'idaa imaa sa etemagadinig.
"Wegonesh iw giin genawaabandaman?"
"Oon, wedi gosha, enigoowigamigoonsing inganawaabamaa enigoons bebaamooded."
"Naa, giwaabamaa na gaye giin awedi enigoons?"
Mii dash aw bezhig ezhi-igod, iw isa ikido, "Aaniish, gaawiin inde-gashkitoosiin ji-waabamag, aanawi dash iw wiin igo inde-noondawaa eta go madwe'ooded gosha!"

Aaniish mii sa iw, wiin geget igo gii-pakinaaged giiwenh aw nwaandawaad, mii sa gii-amwaad wiineta go iniw abinooijiinyan, weweni sa go gii-mino-wiisini, mii sa gaawiin miinawaa gii-wiisinisii baanimaa bijiinag wiikaa.
Mii sa go maa go minik ekoozid.
Mewinzha gii-paatayiinowag ingiw anishinaabeg.
Eni-agoojinid iniw manoominike-giizisoon ezhinikaazonid, mii go bijiinag ani-maajii-manoominikewaad.
Aabiding dash igo gii-ayaawag ingodwewaan anishinaabeg, Miskobines, Makoons, gaye, mii ezhinikaazowaad.
Mii ezhi-ozhigewaad, wiigiwaamikewaad, ozhiitaawaad wii-bawa'amowaad.
Ingoding dash bezhig gaagiigido ezhi-ikidod, "Inga-bawa'am ina?"
"Gaawiin gosha.
Inga-bawa'am.
Giin dash giga-gaandakii'ige," gii-ikido Makoons.
Mii sa go niigaan akeyaa ezhi-namadabid ji-bawa'ang aw Makoons.
Igo gaye, ishkweyaang niibawi ji-gaandakii'iged aw Miskobines.
Mii dash niminaaweshkaawaad.
Aa, aapiji sa go minwabi aw Makoons bekish dash naana'idaa ezhi-bakobiised aw Miskobines.
Gii-paapi Makoons.
"Gego naa baapiken.
Gegaa go ingii-kibwanaabaawe gosha," ikido Miskobines.
Ginwenzh gii-manoominikewag.
Ishkwaa-manoominikewaad, biidoowaad imaa endaawaad iw manoomin.
Miish imaa ezhi-baasamowaad, gidasigewaad, mimigoshkamowaad, biinitoowaad, na'enimowaad, gaye.
Mii iw akeyaa gaa-izhichigewaad.
Miinawaa gii-maajaa Wenabozho.
Mii go iw apane ko ezhi-babaamosed.
Mii sa eni-babimosed, bijiinag ezhi-noondawaad giiwenh awiiya nagamonid, mii sa yo'ow ena'aminid,
Onabozho yaa wii yaa boock igo...
Yaa wii yaa kwe yaa wii yaa kwe...
Yaa e oo haaw wii yaa wiiya haya wiiya haya kwe yoo,
Onabozho ingoji go apa'iwegwen...
E a we he yaa wii yaa kwe yoo,
Onabozho yaa wii yaa booch igo...
Yaa e oo haaw wii yaa wiiya haya wiiya haya kwe yoo,
Onabozho menopogozid indaa-amwaa...
E a we he yaa wii yaa kwe yoo,
Onabozho yaa wii yaa booch igo...
Yaa wii yaa kwe yaa wii yaa kwe...
Yaa e oo haaw wii yaa wiiya haya wiiya haya kwe yoo.
Wenabozho ezhi-ikidod giiwenh, "Aw waa-amwaad Wenabozhon, yo'owidi anaamibag iidog danwewidam gosha!"
Aaniish mii sa iw, iw dash azhigwa ogii-inaan Wenabozho, "Anaamakamig isa inga-apa'iwe!"
Mii dash igo miinawaa maajii-nagamonid,
Onabozho yaa wii yaa booch igo...
Yaa wii yaa kwe yaa wii yaa kwe...
Yaa e oo haaw wii yaa wiiya haya wiiya haya kwe yoo,
Onabozho anaamakamig apa'iwegwen...
E a we he yaa wii yaa kwe yoo,
Onabozho yaa wii yaa booch igo...
Yaa e oo haaw wii yaa wiiya haya wiiya haya kwe yoo,
Onabozho menopogozid indaa-amwaa...
E a we he yaa wii yaa kwe yoo,
Onabozho yaa wii yaa booch igo...
Yaa wii yaa kwe yaa wii yaa kwe...
Yaa e oo haaw wii yaa wiiya haya wiiya haya kwe yoo.
Miinawaa ezhi-giigidod Wenabozho, i'iw dash azhigwa go giiwenh enaad, "Ishpiming isa inga-apa'iwe!"
Mii dash geget igo miinawaa gii-madwe-nagamonid imaa anaamibag iniw gaa-tanwewidaminid,
Onabozho yaa wii yaa booch igo...
Yaa wii yaa kwe yaa wii yaa kwe...
Yaa e oo haaw wii yaa wiiya haya wiiya haya kwe yoo,
Onabozho ishpiming apa'iwegwen...
E a we he yaa wii yaa kwe yoo,
Onabozho yaa wii yaa booch igo...
Yaa e oo haaw wii yaa wiiya haya wiiya haya kwe yoo,
Onabozho menopogozid indaa-amwaa...
E a we he yaa wii yaa kwe yoo,
Onabozho yaa wii yaa booch igo...
Yaa wii yaa kwe yaa wii yaa kwe...
Yaa e oo haaw wii yaa wiiya haya wiiya haya kwe yoo.
Mii dash azhigwa giiwenh ekidod Wenabozho, "Awegwen igo wa'aw waa-amwid?"
Imaa dash geget igo obabaa-nandobaakinaan giiwenh iniw gaa-tanwewidaminid imaa nandawaabamaad.
Dibi iidog.
Wegwaagi!
Imaa dash ogii-mikawaan giiwenh gichi-waawaabishkimoosen.
Aatayaa!
Aaniish mii sa iw.
"Aa, mii wa'aw geget igo waa-amwid gosha," odizhi-inaan giiwenh.
Mii dash imaa gwayak aw Wenabozho ezhi-gaashkiishkigijiibinaad, ingoji go dash geget igo ezhi-apabaginaad.
Aaniish mii sa iw.
Mii sa azhigwa ezhi-madwe-biibaagid Wenabozho.
"Ambeshke naa, waawaabishkimoose!
Naa, bizindawishin!
Giga-ani-igoog inzhishenyag," ogii-inaan dash igo.
Mii sa go iniw -- anishinaabeg enaawaajin anishinaaben -- "Inzhishenh”.
Mii sa iw minik.
